kai_marketing: Quick coordinated ask for launch week: marketing needs reproducible numbers + artifacts for streaming gen tail (p95/p99), embeddings latency (p95), and cost/1k tokens. Want a smoke now and full sweep Tue night. Can runtime take on a focused sanity run?

sam_runtime: Yep. We need exact model tags, payload pack, which streaming flush configs, and whether you want p99 or jitter percentiles included. Also where to put embargoed artifacts?

kai_marketing: Models: redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 (2026-03-01) and redwood-alpha-7b:quant8-lite (2026-03-08). Payload: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-stream-v2.json. Streaming flush knobs: 15ms and 40ms. Smoke: 50 samples per combination. Full: streaming 3k, long-complete 1k, embeddings 6k (batch=12). Include stratified slices (web/mobile/api), jitter (ms stddev), p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU power draw. Drop to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-2971234567/ embargo ACL.

maya_ops: I'll create the S3 folder and set embargo until 2026-04-07; watchers: marketing + platform-metrics. Will also pin a short README about retention and access.

sam_runtime: Measurement defs for clarity: server-side start->last-byte; streaming token flush measured at emitter; cold-start = first request after >=5m idle. Steady-state defined after 20 warmup requests. We'll provide: aggregated CSV, percentile curves, 100 annotated raw traces (across slices), per-request CSV (request_id,model,variant,flush_ms,seq_in,seq_out,tokens,latency_ms,gpu_util_pct,power_w,trace_url), run config + seed. Seed: 20260405 for determinism.

kai_marketing: Legal wants tolerances we can publish so comms can pre-clear phrasing. Prefer suggestions from runtime. Also include a one-line human summary and a 1-paragraph embargo blurb.

oliver_legal: Recommended public tolerances: p95 headline +/-10%, p99 +/-12%, cost delta <=15%. Avoid comparative absolutes like "no difference" unless within 5% p95 and 3% p99. For streaming, prefer absolute ms numbers for cold-start and flush latencies.

sam_runtime: Agreed. Plan: 1) run smoke now with seed=20260405 for quick go/no-go, 2) if within tolerances schedule full sweep Tue 02:00-06:00 in low-traffic window. Smoke ETA ~2h. If you want faster, ops can allocate burst nodes (cost note provided). Perf CLI we'll include in artifacts.

kai_marketing: Proceed with smoke. Please tag #marketing on completion and upload artifacts to the S3 path above with embargo.

perf-bot: bench job queued  job id bench-2971234567-smoke. Estimated runtime 1h50m.

sam_runtime: Repro CLI (perf command) for the record:
```
redwood-bench run \\
  --model redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 \\
  --model redwood-alpha-7b:quant8-lite \\
  --payload s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-stream-v2.json \\
  --samples 50 \\
  --seed 20260405 \\
  --flush 15,40 \\
  --out s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-2971234567/smoke/
```

perf-bot: bench-2971234567-smoke completed  summary.csv and traces uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-2971234567/smoke/. Preliminary highlights: fp16 streaming (flush15ms) p95=158ms p99=240ms, quant8-lite streaming (flush15ms) p95=174ms p99=265ms, embeddings (batch12) p95=23ms. Cost delta quant8-lite ~13% lower. GPU power draw steady-state: fp16 145W, quant8-lite 138W.

kai_marketing: Nice. Can runtime draft one-line summaries and a short embargoed paragraph + recommended public sentence for the blog? Also include suggested wording for the webinar demo script noting flush settings.

sam_runtime: Draft one-liners (prelim):
- redwood-alpha-7b:fp16  streaming p95 158ms (flush15ms), p99 240ms; baseline cost.
- redwood-alpha-7b:quant8-lite  streaming p95 174ms (+10%), p99 265ms (+10%), cost ~13% lower on test payload.
- Embeddings (batch12)  p95 23ms.
Embargoed blurb (internal): "Internal benchmarks on representative streaming and embedding workloads show quantized variants reduce per-token compute cost with measured tail-latency tradeoffs under controlled settings. See appendix for methodology, flush settings, raw traces, and per-slice breakdowns."

oliver_legal: Change "measured" to "measured" (OK) and include methodology link: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-2971234567/methodology.txt. Also add the approved tolerances.

sam_runtime: Will update and prepare the full sweep if smoke passes tolerances. Deliverables listed: aggregated CSV, percentile PNGs, 100 annotated traces, run config + seed, perf CLI, one-line summaries, embargo blurb, and final recommended public phrasing. We'll tag job bench-2971234567-full when scheduled.

kai_marketing: Thanks  ping #marketing when full sweep is queued and again when artifacts are live. Also add a short recommended quote for the blog author.

perf-bot: tag:complete :white_check_mark:
